creator_type: parent creator (family travel recommendations; caption 'אנחנו חמישה')
product: Backpacks bought on AliExpress for a family of five (pink and blue-grey travel backpacks with a laptop pocket); no brand visible
disclosure_visible: none visible (caption has AliExpress affiliate-style discount codes and a search code, no disclosure word)
format: packing demo: hands-only pack-with-me with burned-in text and no speech, bookended by travel clips of children

hook_0_3s.opening_image: A girl about 10 seen from behind with a pink backpack walks along an aircraft aisle past two smiling flight attendants and a man
hook_0_3s.spoken: none (the machine transcript is song lyrics, e.g. 'כל אחד צריך חוות את התיקתם', not speech)
hook_0_3s.on_screen_text: 'כן, באמת טסנו ל-10 ימים עם תיקי גב בלבד'
hook_0_3s.reason_to_keep_watching: Interpretation: an extreme claim (10 days, five people, backpacks only) that begs for proof; the next shots show the packing.

shots.subject: Girl with backpack walking down the aircraft aisle, from behind
Open pink backpack being packed: 6 tops, 3 pairs of trousers, underwear, swimwear, then headphones, deodorant, brush, fan; caption lists contents
Second open blue-grey backpack packed with clothes, headphones in a mesh pocket, a charger and toiletries; captions on the apartment, washing machine and a weight of 5 kg per bag
Two children from behind with backpacks on a city street, then a pink backpack under an aircraft seat

how_value_is_shown: By packing: items are placed one by one into an open backpack with text naming them, so the viewer sees the amount that fits; at the end the bag is shown under an airline seat.
demonstration: Hands loading clothes, headphones, brush, toiletries and chargers into two backpacks; the backpack shown under a seat on the plane.
proof: The packed contents, a stated weight of 5 kg per bag (caption: 4 to 5 kg), children walking with the backpacks and the bag under the seat.
emotion: Practical, a little proud and show-off.
personal_story: Caption: a ten-night trip to the Azores and Thailand with five people; the parents bought their own bags two years earlier and the children's a few weeks before.
selling_language: 'כן, באמת טסנו ל-10 ימים עם תיקי גב בלבד' (on screen); 'כל תיק שקל 5 ק"ג' (on screen); 'חמשתנו טסנו רק עם תיק גב והיה נפלא' (on screen)
captions_on_screen: headline text: bold white text with a dark outline across the lower third, one or two lines per beat; 'לינק ומידע בתיאור' at the end
editing_rhythm: 5 shots by ffmpeg in 18 s, plus several caption changes inside continuous overhead shots; about 3.6 s per shot; no jump cuts evident
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: a pink backpack under a plane seat with the captions 'וכמובן שזה נכנס מתחת למושב' and 'לינק ומידע בתיאור'. Caption: follow, comment 'תיקים' for AliExpress links, three discount codes and a search code.
price_or_code: caption: discount codes ($2 off orders $15, $4 off orders $30, $9 off orders $65) and a search code AYZP8J; no price for the backpacks
convincing: Interpretation: a measurable promise (10 days, 5 kg), a visible packing sequence, the bags shown on real family travel; 914 comments (public count) suggests the comment-word CTA worked, not a sales measure.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: the product is a generic bag so there is no brand to remember; overhead clips look phone-made and are plain; the first bag's contents change quickly.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: open with a bold claim as a burned-in headline, show the product being filled or used with hands only, and send links via a comment word; a no-voice, no-face overhead shot is easy to film solo at home.
solo_without_child: partly, the packing demo is hands only (no child needed), the opening and ending use children from behind
not_verified: Whether the hands packing the bags are the children's or the parent's; brand of the bags; whether a song plays (inferred from transcript lyrics). Counts read 15 Oct: plays 198007, likes 975, comments 914. Upload 2026-06-27.
